name: INDOF.CBP SUK.MAKM.RP 50
summary: Indofood CBP Sukses Makmur Tbk is an Indonesian company engaged in the production of instant noodles, dairy products, snack foods, food seasonings, and beverages. It's one of the largest food companies in Indonesia. Indofood CBP Sukses Makmur Tbk is headquartered in Jakarta, Indonesia.
